title: Amber matrix
text: For the Amber matrix [[3, 1], [2, 4]], the determinant is 10. The trace is 7.

title: Birch polynomial
text: The Birch function is f(x) = x^3 - 2x. Its derivative is f'(x) = 3x^2 - 2.

title: Cobalt urn
text: The Cobalt urn contains three red and two blue balls. A single uniform draw has red probability 3/5.

title: Delta sequence
text: The Delta arithmetic sequence starts at 7 and has common difference 4. Its sixth term is 27.

title: Ember congruence
text: The Ember calculation reduces 38 modulo 7. The remainder is 3.

title: Fjord integral
text: The definite integral of 2x from 0 to 3 is 9. The antiderivative used is x^2.

title: Grove triangle
text: The Grove right triangle has legs 5 and 12. Its hypotenuse is 13.

title: Harbor sample
text: The Harbor sample is [2, 4, 4, 10]. Its arithmetic mean is 5 and its median is 4.

title: Iris logarithm
text: The Iris expression log base 2 of 32 evaluates to 5.

title: Jade vectors
text: The dot product of Jade vectors [1, 3] and [4, 2] is 10.

title: Linden exponential
text: The Linden equation 3^x = 81 has solution x = 4.
